# telnyx_requirement_types (Data Source)

The types of regulatory requirement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name_contains` (String) Filters requirement types to those whose name contains a certain string.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (List of String) Specifies the sort order for results. If you want to sort by a field in ascending order, include it as a sort parameter. If you want to sort in descending order, prepend a `-` in front of the field name.

### Read-Only

- `requirement_types` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirement_types))

<a id="nestedatt--requirement_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirement_types`

Read-Only:

- `acceptance_criteria` (Attributes) Specifies objective criteria for acceptance (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirement_types--acceptance_criteria))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `description` (String) Describes the requirement type
- `example` (String) Provides one or more examples of acceptable documents
- `id` (String) Identifies the associated document
- `name` (String) A short descriptive name for this requirement_type
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource
- `type` (String) Defines the type of this requirement type
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--requirement_types--acceptance_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirement_types.acceptance_criteria`

Read-Only:

- `acceptable_characters` (String) Specifies the allowed characters as a string
- `acceptable_values` (List of String) Specifies the list of strictly possible values for the requirement. Ignored when empty
- `locality_limit` (String) Specifies geography-based acceptance criteria
- `max_length` (Number) Maximum length allowed for the value
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum length allowed for the value
- `time_limit` (String) Specifies time-based acceptance criteria
